tei:div.tei:p: 559)༄༅/ 'dul ba gri yi zin bris 'don bder bkod pa bzhugs so*//

560) che mchog he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ rab 'jigs dus me'i klong dkyil nas// rngams pa'i hoṃ zhal 'bar ba'i ljags// sa gsum drag shul mi srun 'goms/ gu ru drag he ru ka dpal 'dud// srid pa'i bsreg rdzas nyon mongs rakta'i klung*// chos nyid rngams zhal gnyis med hub kyis rol// ma rung gzung 'dzin kun rtags gdon bgegs mnan// dpal chen 'dus rtsal 'bar ba'i gur du bsnyen/ de yang bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i 'dul ba gri yi las kyi kha 'phang zin bris su bstar ba la'ang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo/ dang po ni/ drag po'i gzhung dang mthun pa'i sar phyin pa'am yang na gri sri gnas bar/ gzhung dang mthun nges kyi cho ga dmod pa drag sngags kyi stob pa'i mthar phyin tsa na/ skyer sogs rtsub pa'i shing tshad dang mthun par bcad la/ dpal dgu bka' srung dang bcas pa'i thig tshon dkyil 'khor ji lta bar blugs/ ma grub tshe phyag bzhes bzhin bkod par yam shing brtsegs/ mtha' bskor lha bshos nag po dgu/ dmar gtor dgu/ chang bu rtse can nag por bya/ sreg rdzas cha dgu bka' srung bcas/ gshed kyi gzugs dgu dgra bgegs ling ga dgu/ hom mthar skyer gtsang rtse mor ling ga sum ltebs can btsugs/ gzhan yang sman raka gtor ma sogs 'og tu mkho ba rnams tshags su tshud par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhung gi mchod rdzas byin brlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ bsregs rdzas byin rlabs ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las (561)ye shes kyi ka pā la mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rang rang gi dpal dang yon tan phun gsum tshogs par gnod byed gri sri gri btsan rnams 'dul ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes bsam/ bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las raṃ dmar nag chad pa las/ oṃ raṃ dzwa la hūṃ phaṭaḥ zhes brjod la dbus kyi 'jig rten sa la me 'bar ro/

rang mthun thab kyi me klong du/ me lha sngo nag ral pa can// spyan gsum dmar zlum mche bzhi gcing*// phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis bgrang phreng dang*// ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa'o// g.yon gnyis skyabs sbyin dbyug pa 'phyar// thod pa'i phreng bas sku la brgyan// gsang ba'i sbubs nas me stag 'phro// sku smad sbrul gyi chun pos brgyan// ra skyes khams pa'i rwa gnyis las// 'ja' 'od dang ni glog zhags 'khrugs// mi ro'i ya mgal ma mgal gyi// sga yi snga ru phyi ru dang*// pags pa'i sga g.yogs byas steng bzhugs// sku la me ri me dpung 'phro/ khro gdong bral ba'i byams sems kyis// gri gshed bsad pa'i las mdzad gyur/ zhes bsam/ gter gzhung las / me lha'i rgyal po drang srong chen po= sogs nas/ tshe 'das (562)bag chags ma lus bsreg tu gsol/ dpal dgu bka' srung dang bcas pa so so'i sngags mthar/ gnod byed gri sri gri gshed ma rā ya dzwa la raṃ khā hiḥ zhes pas/ shug pa/ bal bu/ 'bru sna/ thun rdzas dang bcas pa lan 'dun re 'bul/ de nas zur bskol ni/ mdun du e las dug gsum gyi// ngo bor gyur pa'i chos 'byung ni// dmar nag kha dog gting zab pa'i// nang du nṛḥdang triḥyig gzugs// de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas// gnod byed dgra bgegs dmigs bya rnams// sha rul dag la sbrang bu bzhin// 'dus shing thim pas dgra dang bgegs// so so ma yin ro gcig ltar// ling gar phung khams skye mched rdzogs// mya ngan nyams thag 'gul bskyod bral// gnod byad kun 'dus ngo bor gsal// bdag nyid yi dam lhar gsal ba'i/ kha bdud rtsi sman gyi gtso mo byed par gyur cig me 'gal shar lhor gzug la/ hoḥ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bdag gi sbyin bsregs ma rdzogs bar// me yi lha ni bzhugs su gsol/ padma ka ma lā ye st+waṃ/ ba ye be yaṃ raṃ/ zhes me lha dpang por gzhug go

slar yang hom dbus me la me sbar te/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me dpung chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du bhruṃ (563)las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su che mchog yon tan gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs dkar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badzra sa ma dza/ de nas gzhung las/ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni= sogs nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las chad pa'i// phyag rgya'i lha mo bzhi 'phros pas// gnod byed 'gugs 'ching sdom myos kyis// 'gugs pa'i las la brtson par gyur/ zhes bsam la 'gugs pa ni/ na mo/ mchog gsum rtsa gsum bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par du che mchog yon tan gyi= yang dag thugs kyi= 'jam dpal sku yi= padma gsung gi= phur pa phrin las kyi= ma mo rbod gtong gi= bla ma rig 'dzin= 'jig rten mchod bstod= dmod pa drag sngags kyi= dpal gyi bka' sdod kyi= lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul phyag brnyan dang bcas pa rnams kyi= chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthu stobs nus pa la brten nas tshe 'das (564)che ge mo gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus su thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la bar du gcod pa'i za 'dre shi gshed srog gcod dbugs len byed pa'i gri sri gri btsan la sogs pa gnod byed gshed ma'i rigs su gyur pa spyi dang*/ khyad par du yang gri sri ming sring bco brgyad kyi nang mtshan dmigs pa'i yul du gyur pa/ mda' gri stong dmar/ mdung gri sbubs dmar/ me gri tshig pa/ ral gri gtub pa/ gcan gri mche dmar/ shing gri jo zed/ chu gri 'dar shad/ gad gri phyags pa/ bu gri 'gab dmar/ gri gri smug po/

thog gri tshig pa/ 'gag gri mig 'bur/ 'thib gri sug po/ 'brum gri khams 'dzag rdo gri gdan dmar/ dug gri sbos pa/ rta gri shog dmar/ rba gri g.yeng ba/ la sogs pa gri sri gri btsan gang yin thams cad gzugs ling ga 'di la khug cig badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ci nus brjod la phur bskor bya ba ni/ don 'dun las/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ sogs so sor kha bsgyur shes par bya'o/ che mchog lha tshogs dus la bab: yang dag= 'jam dpal= dbang chen= phur pa'i= rbod gtong= rig 'dzin= (565) mchod bstod= drag sngags= bka' sdod= bcas kha bsgyur shes par bya'o/ dpal dgu bka' srung dang bcas pa'-i sngags/ zhal stab yang dpal dgu bka' srung dang bcas pa la bsgyur bar bya'o/ gtor 'bul yang kha bsgyur ro/ bhyoḥbhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: zhes bhyo gdab mtha' bar btang*/ gzhung las / hūm̐: che mchog yab yum sprul pa'i byin brlabs las: sogs nas/ tshe 'phos lha ru skye bar shog: ces pa'i bar btang*/ de nas las byang las/ che mchog nas bzung dpal dgu bka' srung dang bcas pa'i bstod pa rim bzhin byar mthar/ hūm̐ḥ che mchog yon tan lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyi/ rmad byung rol pa'i bsreg rdzas mchod gtor bzhes// 'dod pa'i don grub gdon bgegs zhi ba dang*/ mi mthun gri sri zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// yang dag thugs kyi 'jam dpal sku yi padma gsung gi= phur pa phris= ma mo rbod gtong= rig 'dzin slob dpon= 'jig rten mchod bstod= dmod pa drag sngags= dpal gyi bka' srung= bcas kha bsgyur nas gong gi 'dod gsol tshig rkang gsum 'di thams cad la 'gres so/ yang dag gi shar me sbar/ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shar gyi me dpung chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i klong du bhruṃ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ

thugs kar hūm̐ḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ 566) badzra sa ma dzaḥ sa spyan drangs 'dul gzhung las/ hūm̐ḥ dad pa dang ni sogs/ sbyangs du gsol: bar drag sngags so lnga'i shams bur / gnod byed gri sri gri gshed ma ra ya dzwa la raṃ khā hiḥ ces rdzas 'bul zhinga'agres byang zur bskol sbyar ro/ 'jam dpal ni lho yi me sbar la/ swa bhā wa= sogs nas shar gyi mal du/ lho/ nub/ byang*/ shar lho/ lho nub/ nub byang*/ byang shar/ dkyil 'khor gyi bar khyams su/ zhes kha bsgyur bas 'thus so/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs= zhes pa'i tshab tu / 'jam dpal sku yi/ padma gsung*/ phur pa phrin las kyi/ ma mo rbod gtong gi rig 'dzin slob dpon gyi/ 'jig rten chos bstod kyi/ dmod pa drag sngags kyi/ dpal gyi bka' sdod kyi/ zhes kha bsgyur ro/ de ltar na rim bzhin zur bskol sbyar ba dang*/ drag sngags shams bu bcas 'gres byas nas bka' sdod mtha' bar btang ngo*/ de nas bka' sdod kyi zur bskol sbyar mthar me 'gal thab tu gzhug nas/ hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil pa'i gzhal yas nas: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i mchod pa 'di: me lha drang srong 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: tshe 'das bag chags ma lus bsreg tu gsol: oṃ agne ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya swa hā: gnod byed gri sri gri gshed ma ra ya dzwa la raṃ khā hi/ ces me lha la rdzas lhag ma 'bul nas/ bstod pa ni/ 567) tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs la khyab pa'i gtso// thugs rje sprul pa'i rigs sngags 'chang*// nyon mongs bsreg byed ye shes 'od// thugs rje'i me dpung gzi brjid che// rdzu 'phrul 'bar ba'i zhabs dang ldan/ thabs kyi sprul pas ra la bcibs// bsgrang phreng 'dzin cing rigs sngags 'chang*// bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gundhai bsnams// 'jig rten yongs la tshim par mdzad// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten dag na mya ngan 'das// zhi ba'i ngang gis thugs rje che// de la mchod 'bul bstod phyag 'tshal/

zhes dang*/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs su gsol// gtan nas gshegs pa ma lags te// slar yang sems can la byon/ zhes me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ tshe 'das kyi gzugs brnyan drim rten bcas bsang sbyang ba ni/ oṃ ma hā shun+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bha ba atma ko3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du nṛḥyongs su gyur pa las tshe las 'das pa che ge mo de nyid phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal bar gyur/ 568) bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can glogs zhags ltar myur bar 'phros pas tshe 'das kyi rnam par shes pa 'gro ba bdun po'i gnas mchog dman gang na yod pa der phog pa tsam gyi dga' zhing gus pas sems 'dza' bcugs dam bca' dran pa bzhin rang gi gzugs brnyan la thim par gyur/ zhes bsam la/ 'gugs pa bya ba ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi= khyad par du yang bde shegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka'= gnas yul dur khrod dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i bka'= chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba las kyi dbang gis ngan song song sogs sdug bsngal dang mya ngan gyi yul gang du gnas pa'i sa nas skad cig yud tsam la gzugs brnyan ming rus dri gos dang bcas pa 'di la mchis par mdzod cig aḥnṛ suḥtriḥpreḥduḥ.a karṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ

lan ci nus bzlas mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshe 'das de nyid cho ga'i (579) bya ba rdzogs kyi bar gar yang 'gro ba'i 'dushes med par bsam mo/ chos bshad ni 'dul 'og tu/ skye ba nges med sems can khyod// 'gro drug gnas su 'khyams pa la// las dang thugs rje'i dam tshig gis// ye shes lcags kyu'i drangs shing dgug a nri su tri pre du dzaḥ tshe las 'das pa de rigs drug gang du skyes pa'i lus bshig nas sngar son po'i cha lugs 'jag ma'i gzugs dang dbyer med du mos la de yi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ lte bar swa/ gsang gnas su hā rnams bkod pas thar lam la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs gang gis mi tshugs par rgyas gdab la bzhag de nas tshe 'das kyi lan chags sbyong ba'i phyir / rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i bgegs tshogs tshim par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhū?ṃ/ lan gsum nam mkha' mdzod du spel/ dang po lha yi lan chags sbyor phyir bsngo ba ni/ hūṃ/ gtor ma 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa 'di/ tshe 'das 'dod pa'i lan chags bsnyags pa yi// gson bdud gshin lcags lan chags khyod la sbyin// gtor ma 'di yis mgu zhing tshim gyis la// tshe 'das 'di yi thar pa'i gegs ma byed/ sarba bhu ta ba ling ta khā hi/ 'di ni 'gro ba bdun po'i mgor sbyar dgos zhing*/ de yang 'dod pa'i= zhes pa'i mal du rim bzhin/ 'thab rtsod/ bu lon/ 570) bkol spyod/ rku 'phrog tsha grang*/ zhes kha bsgyur ro/ de nas 'dul gzhung las/ hūm̐/ dang po gri byung gang nas byung*/ sogs nas / ded dpon du gyur cig 'og tu sdig dral ni/ skye bar nges pa'i= stong gsum mun nag= sogs nas/ ye shes lha dang phrad par shog bar gzhung bzhin no/ nub dang po rnams su zlog pa'i zhal bstab nas bzung zlog pa btang ngo*/ nub mtha' mar me lha mi gshegs par 'jag gzugs hom dbus ma'i nang du bsreg cing lhag ma dor/

hūm̐: gson shig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: phung po lnga yi bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar re: 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la: lha mo lnga yi me sbar re: nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la: ye shes lnga yi me sbar re: byang chub sems kyi me sbar ro: yum rnams drug gi bud shing la lha mo brgyad kyi me sbar ro: lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro: badzra satwa mu: agne ye dzwa la raṃ raṃ: hūm̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil pa'i me nang du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i sbyin bsreg dang: rten 'brel rgyu las byung ba'i phung po 'bul: tshe 'das las kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: gri rgab 571) shi 'phro bcad du gsol: oṃ ma ma sarba siddhi ku ru swa hā: oṃ ma ma sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi shud ddhe swa hā: tshe 'das kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sarba pa paṃ da ha na badzra ye swa hā: rigs kyi bu che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad shantiṃ ku ru ye swa hā: gzugs stong pa'o/ stong pa nyid gzugs so/

sogs/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ zhes me sbar ro/ mthar smon lam ci rigs gdab bo/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni/ bsregs pa'i thal ba gzhung chu'i nang du bor ro dmigs bsal la mnan pa dgos na shog ling bsregs pa'i thal ba dang shog ling gzhan zhig bcas gzhung ltar mnan no/ smras pa/ khams gsum dug lnga'i rang gzugs kun brtags pa'i// snang ba 'dre bgegs gri sri'i klad 'gems byed// 'bar ba'i so phrag glal 'di gri yi las// 'don bder bkod des kun kyang 'khrul grol shog ces pa'ang dpal chen 'dus pas he ru ka'i bka' lung ji bzhin rang blor mi brjed pa'i zin bris sug bris su bstar ba dge'o// sarba da ka lye bha wantu// dge'o//
